reference.source: WorldFires public API geometry attributed to EFFIS / Copernicus EMS
reference.provenance_gap: An original EFFIS 2024 regional WFS query (387 features, 206 marked MK) returned no geometry intersecting this reference. Absence there does not establish no fire; it leaves this extent unconfirmed.

mcd64a1.note: Valid-QA cells (QA bit 1) with burn day 1-7 Sep 2024 in the case crop, drawn as native ~463 m cells; coarse product, not an incident edge.

open_meteo_historical_forecast.interpretation: Retrospective model forecast context at a snapped grid point; not a local station record, fuel-moisture measure, or fire-spread validation.

methods.hls_qa: Reject fill 255, Fmask cloud/adjacency/shadow/snow/water bits 1-5, and high-aerosol class 3 in bits 6-7.
methods.nbr: (S30 B8A - B12)/(B8A + B12); dNBR is 2024-08-23 minus 2024-09-12. Thresholds are sensitivity summaries, not calibrated severity classes.
methods.mcd64a1: Count valid 500-m cells with burn date DOY 245-251; approximate cell area is not a precise burned-area estimate.
methods.terrain: NASADEM bilinear-resampled to 30 m; slope from central differences, approximate terrain context.
methods.land_cover: WorldCover 2021 nearest-resampled to 30 m; descriptive cover, not fuel-model or fuel-moisture data.
methods.firms: Existing CSV thermal-anomaly detections inside the EFFIS-derived polygon; a detection is not a perimeter or independent ground truth.
methods.reference: The perimeter is the EFFIS-attributed geometry exposed by WorldFires' public API; it was not independently obtained from the official EFFIS archive.
methods.spread: No rate-of-spread or future fire-front prediction is estimated.

evidence_image.alt: Mariovo evidence overview: HLS pre/post scenes, dNBR, MODIS burn dates, terrain and land cover around the reference perimeter.

gibs.credit: NASA EOSDIS GIBS / Worldview; MODIS Terra Corrected Reflectance
gibs.note: Daily browse composite; not numeric reflectance, severity or a perimeter. Clouds and smoke may obscure the surface.
